mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,resource_id,processing_status FROM api_idempotency_record WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE api_idempotency_record SET resource_id=#{resourceId},resource_type='SHIPMENT_ORDER',processing_status='SUCCEEDED',response_status=200 WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} AND processing_status='PROCESSING'
